details.report: Closed exactly LifecycleAdmissionExclusion, RecoveryStateContinuity, and LedgerTemporaryPublicationSafety. Added production-seam crash barriers after action reservation, recovered publication, and settled post-navigation; proved call/end exclusion before Navigator launch, during reservation and post-navigation windows, and after end; proved replay preserves one selected invocation, durable latestAttempt, pre/post receipts, and no duplicate role launch; added ledger publication/cleanup I/O injection and verified AggregateError retains both primary cause and cleanup cause. No locks, timeouts, retries, or scheduler added. Gates passed: npm run typecheck; npm test (404 pass, 5 skip, 0 fail); npm run build:recorder; npm pack --dry-run; git diff --check. Commits: 43580ae57f2b90d455a70819c47d0b90d7d4928e and generated-artifact forward commit ccb894450a7b9b9cbd57b5f5fa26242bd0827181. Worktree clean.
